title: Important Notice: Late Fee Policy Implementation for Spring 2026
text:
🚨 Important Notice: Late Fee Policy Implementation for Spring 2026

This is to inform you that as per the fee submission policy, a fine of Rs. 1000 per day will be imposed on all outstanding semester dues starting from April 13, 2026.

Students who have not yet deposited their semester fee are strongly advised to clear their dues immediately to avoid the fine.

Please note that it is mandatory to clear all outstanding dues at the earliest to avoid further penalties or administrative actions.

For any fee-related concerns or assistance, kindly contact the Students Cell at the Treasurer Office.

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan | Official Notification
